newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Kohl says he wants to run again in 1998 election.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says he wants to run again in 1998 election.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl told ARD television on Thursday he wanted to run for reelection in the 1998 general election.
Asked in an interview if he wanted to run again, Kohl said: "A very clear yes. I will stand again if my party and political friends want that."

Kohl, a Christian Democrat who is already post-war Germany's longest-serving chancellor, took office in 1982 and has defeated four Social Democratic (SPD) challengers at the polls since then. The next election is due in late 1998.
His political allies have been urging him to declare his candidacy early to help rally support within the party and put pressure on the SPD.
